critique.title: Self critique
items: White dominates; colour only appears for action, selection and state (buttons, active tab, correct/wrong badges).
No card grid; the test list is a lined DataTable.
Radii are hierarchical: controls 6px, panels 8px, dialog 12px.
No emoji, forbidden icons, all-caps labels or blended colour fills; Phosphor Light weight only.
Motion only answers a user action (button transition, tab/dialog opening); no decorative animation.
Copy is action-oriented and exclamation-free ("Save test", "This cannot be undone").
The rail collapses at 390px, every control is keyboard-reachable, and focus rings stay visible.
The ornament I removed: the first draft grew the shadow on button hover; docs/03 allows a single elevation level (floating layers only), so I dropped it.
